defects_found_in_v1.finding: Receipt coverage_history gaps produce no unresolved label; a parent-union row with the gap pid and status ENDED_PROVED (uniqueid may be null) clears it. Contrary to package-v9 4.5 'All historical unproved/failed coverage stays visible and blocking' and 5.4 'retain unresolved coverage. No PID-only ... shortcut', and contrary to scope-v1 mapping (COVERAGE_GAP:n). Interface-v1 refinement 1 mislabelled this change as 'Tightening only'.

Historical unproved identities (receipt unproved_history) are cleared when the parent union marks them ENDED_PROVED; package-v9 4.5 and the receipt's own ownership_residual ('all post-baseline unproved identities block') require them to stay blocking. Scope-v1 also omitted this label.

ACK carries post-receipt coverage_history, unproved_history and contract_violations (full_census retries during the ACK census append to them). v1 consumes only the receipt copies, so post-receipt gaps/unproved identities/violations reported by the supervisor are dropped.

Helper key presence is not required; a non-supervisor19-shaped helper row lacking identity/signal/settled raises KeyError later and is HELD as BRIDGE_INTERNAL_EXCEPTION instead of RECEIPT_INVALID. Unreachable for genuine supervisor19 receipts; fail-closed either way.
